how: LM1: OSM objects with a wikidata tag, or a name and a landmark tag (historic, tourism, place of worship, station, mall, stadium, park, garden), joined to the Wikidata items whose coordinate lies in the same box on the wikidata tag; a name match within 150 m is the flagged fallback. The ASI id is Wikidata P1371 (N-DL-*). The tier is proposed from a score (owner names, ASI listing, sitelinks, footprint size); the owner list and inspector edits win later. A draft: nothing is placed from it.
